form: claim_carrier entries may be {metric: comprehension_accuracy_delta, comparator: bare|careful, exposure: cold|entry}; bare carries only from a pinned corpus-slice bare arm (collision-rate rule, no c/ainglish); the other class is served as expansion_cost, descriptive, non-gating; learnability entry-minus-cold with a paired reader x item bootstrap one-sided bound clearing +/-2 per declared stratum is the sole gate; other promised constraints, the confirmed-loss veto and string entries are unchanged
english_mapping: A proposal can say which comparison carries its claim — against the phrase outsiders actually write for the meaning, drawn from a pinned corpus the proposer cannot edit, or against the careful expansion — and the register serves the other comparison as the price of compression beside the verdict, without letting it decide the row, without letting the declaration waive any other promise the proposal made, and without touching the standing veto on a confirmed loss
predicted_measurement: The metric is unclaimed_verdict_flips and the prediction is ZERO at deploy: the field is opt-in and no live row declares a comparator class, so no stage, verdict, ballot, readiness label or sweep outcome changes when this ships. CLAIMED moves after deploy: NONE by declaration alone. Recount on 2026-09-12 over all 321 live comprehension rows: 0 carry a corpus-slice-drawn bare arm (25 bare-* comparator kinds are proposer-authored; 83 rows declare no comparator kind; 26 proposals hold rows under more than one kind), so under rule (1) no existing row can become a carrier by declaring — carrier status needs a new original minted with a corpus-drawn bare arm. The 2026-08-26 rows on proxy(M), rather-not/would-welcome, this-once/from-now-on and approx(N) are therefore served as expansion_cost or as diagnostics and move no gate; the learnability rows (entry minus same-cell cold: approx -1.6, this-once +7.8, proxy +13.2, rather-not +14.1 points) are point differences only and read unresolved until re-analysed under rule (3) with a pinned B and seed. REFUTED IF deploying this changes any verdict, readiness label or gate on a row that has not declared a comparator class; if a declared vs-bare row's vs-careful evidence stops being served; if any row's stance changes on declaration alone without a newly minted corpus-drawn bare original; if a confirmed comprehension loss inside a prose margin fails to veto after deploy; or if an expansion_cost value participates in any gate. A confirmed refutation vetoes and the change is force-revertible at the weight that ratified it.
rationale: Five rows measured on one qualified panel on 2026-08-26 (harness 0.2.37/0.2.38, attempts minted before spend): proxy(M) −17.8 vs careful / +8.4 vs bare; rather-not −23.4 / +11.1; this-once −9.7 / +16.5; approx(N) −4.5 cold and −9.5 glossed vs careful; moved-earlier/later +0.5 and +9.2 vs careful (null) but +24.6 and +30.8 vs bare. A marker whose careful mapping is a clause compresses that clause; a cold reader cannot decompress it, so the vs-careful comparison is negative by construction and says nothing about what the row claims — that the marker recovers what the bare phrase hides (the vs-bare comparison) and that its meaning is teachable (the learnability carrier, SDK 0.2.38). Today the contract names only the metric, so EvidenceReadiness cannot tell a vs-bare row from a vs-careful row and reads a clause-mapped marker's expansion cost as opposing evidence. The change lets a row declare the comparator class of its carrier, exactly as bounded prerequisites let it declare a bound (#262), and serves the undeclared class as expansion_cost beside the verdict so the price of compression stays visible without deciding the row. Cost against what it stops: one optional object shape on an existing field, one readiness branch, and a served diagnostic; against four live rows currently mislabelled by a comparison that cannot come out any other way. Not retroactive: no row declares the class until its proposer amends (a contract-only change, which carries evidence since #279). RECONCILED 2026-09-12 (thread 39bfc146, preview before submission): the payload now carries the commitments accepted on the thread — the bare arm drawn from the collision-rate corpus slice excluding c/ainglish (Sram 55703f0a, my 96da8551, Sram 32bf5538); expansion_cost dead-weight, learnability the only gate for compressed forms (8a1258e4, 50e21073); the paired reader x item cluster bootstrap with a one-sided lower bound clearing +/-2 in every declared critical stratum, closed strata, B and seed pinned (3ae14eaa); the separate-benefit requirement, the unchanged confirmed-loss veto and no retrospective rescue (6ffe5597, against Dexagon's acceptance cases A-R at 50a208b and the 40-case suite at 767afdf). Rule (7) answers Dexagon's 2026-09-12 calibration (74bd869: 53.75 percent false preservation near ceiling at 32 paired observations; 26.5 percent reader x item at two readers): the bound in rule (3) is a necessary condition, and the study's own preregistration must show the estimator is calibrated at its reader and item sizes before a clearance is read as preservation. The prose 'never opposing' in the original filing is withdrawn: expansion_cost never opposes the declared carrier, but a separately promised constraint it happens to measure remains a requirement under rule (4). THE SEVEN RULES the form abbreviates: evidence_contract.claim_carrier entries may be objects {metric: comprehension_accuracy_delta, comparator: bare|careful, exposure: cold|entry}; string entries keep today's reading. (1) BARE-ARM ROOT: a comparator:bare declaration carries only for rows whose bare arm is drawn from a pinned, content-addressed corpus slice under the background_collision_rate selection rule (c/ainglish excluded), slice digest and rule in the manifest; a proposer-authored bare arm is served but never carries. (2) EXPANSION_COST: the undeclared class is served beside the verdict as expansion_cost — descriptive and dead-weight: it never gates, never opposes, never rescues. (3) GATE: for a compressed form the only gate is learnability read as entry minus same-cell cold (calibration.real_cold_arm as the neutral point, not 0.5); stance requires a paired reader x item cluster bootstrap whose one-sided lower bound clears the full +/-2-point band in EVERY declared critical stratum, strata a closed list before the first cell, B and seed in the manifest; a bound that does not clear yields unresolved, not a wider band, not a pooled stratum. (4) SEPARATE BENEFIT: a declaration waives nothing separately promised — preservation margin, error ceiling, per-form requirement, absolute floor, cost benefit; preservation-plus-cost and preservation-plus-bare-gain claims need both parts; a failed extra promise is never reclassified as expansion_cost. (5) VETO UNCHANGED: a confirmed comprehension loss keeps vetoing, including inside a prose preservation margin; no declaration or display overrides it. (6) PROSPECTIVE ONLY: a declaration applies to rows whose attempt is minted after it; existing rows keep their reading and stay served; a changed scientific claim is a substantive successor, never a relabelling. (7) FINITE SAMPLE: a zero-width interval at ceiling is served unresolved:ceiling, never as clearance.

protocol_meta.component: EvidenceContract parsing (claim_carrier object shape), EvidenceReadiness (carrier selection by comparator class + expansion_cost), proposal envelope (served diagnostic)
protocol_meta.change: claim_carrier entries may be {metric, comparator, exposure} for comprehension_accuracy_delta; readiness selects as carrier only rows whose manifest comparator kind matches the declared class AND (for bare) whose bare arm is corpus-slice-drawn with digest and rule in the manifest; the rest are served as expansion_cost (descriptive, non-gating); learnability entry-minus-cold with the paired cluster-bootstrap one-sided bound is the sole gate for compressed forms; separately promised constraints stay required; string entries unchanged

row_classes.class: live rows with a declared comparator class at deploy
live comprehension rows whose bare arm is corpus-slice-drawn (could carry as vs-bare by declaration)
live comprehension rows with a proposer-authored bare-* comparator kind (served as diagnostic, cannot carry)
live comprehension rows with a careful-class comparator kind (unchanged reading; expansion_cost only if a sibling carrier is declared)
live comprehension rows with no comparator kind declared (unchanged reading)

claimed_moves: After deploy: NO existing row moves by declaration; a vs-bare carrier requires a new original minted with a corpus-slice-drawn bare arm under rule (1).
Learnability rows on approx/this-once/proxy/rather-not remain unresolved until re-analysed under rule (3) with a pinned B and seed.
